title: Dost
desc: A forest ranger joins hands with locals to prevent large-scale poaching that is prevalent in the nearby forests. However, his efforts infuriate a poaching baron who vows to exact revenge.

title: Thaai Mel Aanai
desc: Young Raja resolves to exact revenge for his mother's and sister's deaths. Nevertheless, his law-abiding police officer friend is unwilling to allow him to enforce the law on his own.

title: Vetrivel Sakthivel
desc: Despite having cleared the IPS exam, Sakthivel's father asks him to work in their clothing store. He falls in love with Manju, but her dark past and her father become obstacles to their love.

title: Jodi
desc: Kannan falls in love with Gayathri, but both decide to win the hearts of each other's family members and marry with their consent.

title: Amman
desc: Bhavani is an orphan and an ardent devotee of Goddess Ammoru. The goddess comes to Bhavani's rescue when a vengeful and evil Ghorakh intends to ruin her life.

title: Varna Jalam
desc: A young man moves in with a retired police officer's family, but devises an evil plan to wreck the latter's family.

title: Kadhal FM
desc: A radio jockey falls in love with a fan who often sends song requests. However, when it is time to meet the girl, he suddenly develops an inferiority complex after seeing her.

title: Kadhal Kisu Kisu
desc: Sriram and Indu are classmates who barely know each other. However, her father suspects that they are having an affair and therefore, makes her life miserable.

title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: Vaai Kozhuppu
desc: Bhaskar struggles to earn the admiration and approval of his rich father-in-law. To make matters worse, he is constantly belittled by the elder son-in-law of the family.
